title: Cisco security advisory (AV26-1102)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1102 Date: October 29, 2026 As of October 28, 2026, Cisco is affected by a vulnerability in the following products: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Versions prior to 9.16.4.104, 9.18.4.96, 9.20.4.50, 9.22.3.200, 9.23.1.4, 9.24.1.27 and 9.24.10.1 Cisco Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Versions prior to 7.0.11, 7.2.13, 7.4.9, 7.6.7, 7.7.14, 10.0.3 and 10.1.1 Cisco Network Management and Provisioning License (Smart Software Manager) On-Prem Versions prior to 10-202610 Cisco indicates that CVE-2026-76418 is exploited in the wild. The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance and Secure Firewall Threat Defense Software Remote Access SSL VPN Tunnel Denial of Service Vulnerability Vulnerabilities in Node.js Affecting Cisco Products: October 2026 Cisco Security Advisories Article Link: Cisco security advisory (AV26-1102) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
